title: Creation of Job Descriptions - Community Liaison, Charter Schools and Program Manager, Career Technical Education - Talent/Human Resources Department
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2021-0106 - Creation of Job Descriptions - Community Liaison, Charter Schools; and Program Manager, Career Technical Education, respectively.
headline: Creates job descriptions for a Charter Schools Community Liaison and a Career Technical Education Program Manager
summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0106, which creates two job descriptions: Community Liaison, Charter Schools, and Program Manager, Career Technical Education. No dollar amount is stated in the item.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (6–1), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Futures Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)  2020-2021 between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide after school and school-day support services in areas of Academic Support, Educational Enrichment, Physical Activity and Community Building, virtually, as described in attached Revised Scope of Work and Budget, at Futures Elementary School, in an additional amount of $17,558.00, increasing the MOU not to exceed amount from $120,792.00 to $138,350.00, for the period August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021. All other terms and conditions of the MOU remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant; After School Education and Safety (ASES) Kids Code Grant
headline: Adds $17,558 to Bay Area Community Resources' after school support at Futures Elementary
summary: This changes a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources, adding $17,558 for virtual after school and school-day support at Futures Elementary School. The support covers academic help, enrichment, physical activity and community building. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $120,792 to $138,350 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Oakland Leaf Foundation - After School Program - Bret Harte Middle School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) 2020-2021 between the District and Oakland Leaf Foundation, Oakland, CA, for the latter to increase hours for case management during the school day as well as hiring a subcontractor to facilitate a leadership class at Bret Harte Middle School, in an additional amount of $29,646.00, increasing the MOU not to exceed amount from $180,734.00 to $210,380.00, for the period August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021. funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant, 21st Century Community Learning Centers Grant
headline: Adds $29,646 to Oakland Leaf Foundation's school-day case management at Bret Harte Middle
summary: This changes a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Oakland Leaf Foundation, adding $29,646. outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Rudsdale Continuation School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) 2020-2021 between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to hire an additional staff member to increase academic support available to teachers and students during the day and to provide a driver’s education class two times per week at Rudsdale Continuation School, in an additional amount of $15,238.00, increasing the MOU not to exceed amount from $132,785.00 to $148,023.00, for the period July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.  All other terms and condition of the MOU remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: 21st Century After School Safety and Enrichment for Teens Grant
headline: Adds $15,238 to Bay Area Community Resources for extra staff and driver's education at Rudsdale
summary: This changes a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources, adding $15,238. The money pays for another staff member to increase daytime academic support and for a driver's education class twice a week at Rudsdale Continuation School. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $132,785 to $148,023 for July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 2, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - East Bay Asian Youth Center - After School Program - Urban Promise Academy
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 2, Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)  2020-2021 between the District and East Bay Asian Youth Center, Oakland, CA, for the latter to hire an after school teacher to provide one-to-one academic intervention to up to twelve newcomer and/or special education students for four hours per day at Urban Promise Academy, in an additional amount of $10,397.00, increasing the MOU not to exceed amount from $135,306.00 to $145,703.00, for the period August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021. All other terms and conditions of the MOU remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant
headline: Adds $10,397 for East Bay Asian Youth Center after school tutoring at Urban Promise Academy
summary: This is the second change to a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with East Bay Asian Youth Center. It adds $10,397 to hire an after school teacher who gives one-to-one academic help to up to twelve newcomer and/or special education students, four hours a day, at Urban Promise Academy. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $135,306 to $145,703 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Bunche Academy - Temporary Location - Superintendent of Schools
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2021-0045 - Ratifying the Temporary Location of Bunche Academy at the former Lowell Campus.
headline: Ratifies Bunche Academy's temporary location at the former Lowell Campus
summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0045, which ratifies the temporary location of Bunche Academy at the former Lowell Campus. No dollar amount or end date is stated in the item.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote on April 28 (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

title: Appointment - Member, Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - President, Board of Education
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of President of the Board’s appointment of James Harris (1st term), as a Member of the Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission, effective March 26, 2021, for a term ending January 31, 2023.
headline: Ratifies the Board President's appointment of a member to the Measure N College and Career Readiness Commission
summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of a first-term member to the Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission. The appointment is effective March 26, 2021, for a term ending January 31, 2023.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–1, 1 abstaining), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
